title: A system on the base agrees with the completion of a proper pushforward up to a power of the exceptional ideal
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\mathcal J,\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals, $V=Y\setminus V(\mathcal K)$ ($V(\mathcal K)$ the closed set where $\mathcal K$ is not the unit ideal) and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] such that $f^{-1}(V)\to V$ is an isomorphism. Put $\mathcal I=f^{-1}\mathcal J\cdot\mathcal O_X$. Let $(\mathcal G_n)$ be an object of $\mathit{Coh}(Y,\mathcal J)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent] and $\beta:(f^*\mathcal G_n)\to\mathcal F^\wedge$ an isomorphism in $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-pullback]. Then $f_*\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module, and there are a morphism $\alpha:(\mathcal G_n)\to(f_*\mathcal F)^\wedge$ in $\mathit{Coh}(Y,\mathcal J)$ and an integer $t\ge1$ such that the kernel and the cokernel of $\alpha$, taken in the abelian category $\mathit{Coh}(Y,\mathcal J)$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian], are annihilated by $\mathcal K^t$ (all their terms are killed by $\mathcal K^t$).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088B (lemma-inverse-systems-push-pull), with 'kernel and cokernel annihilated by a power of K' in the sense of Remark 0888 (remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by), whose equivalent conditions (1)-(3) give the annihilation of the kernel and cokernel objects (affine-locally the finite modules Ker(alpha_U), Coker(alpha_U) of Lemma 087W)
